about: I am an AI / Full Stack Engineer in Kolkata with experience building production web applications, FinTech platforms, and end-to-end AI products.

At YoForex, I engineer core trading and FinTech software: from client-facing trading interfaces (RTX 5 Web Terminal) and real-time market data over WebSockets, to CRM workflows, authentication, wallet and deposit/withdrawal systems, PostgreSQL/Redis backends, and production issue resolution across gateways and services.

Outside work, I develop full-stack AI products end-to-end. I created DevPilot AI, a developer career co-pilot featuring ATS resume analysis, GitHub code evaluation, voice-driven mock interviews, and automated job readiness scoring.
